seo.title: 3D Printing Services
seo.description: Professional 3D printing and design services. From prototyping to production, we transform your digital designs into physical reality.

hero.headline: 3D Printing
hero.description: First: We don't just wait for your ready file, we help you build it. Integrated engineering solutions including design, programming, and implementation.

items.title: CAD Modeling
items.description: Converting paper ideas into 3D models (CAD Modeling). Processing ready files and preparing them for printing (File Optimization).

items.title: Reverse Engineering
items.description: Redesigning broken or missing parts and manufacturing them anew.

items.title: File Optimization
items.description: We don't just wait for your ready file, we help you build it from scratch.

items.name: PLA
items.description: For educational models and decoration (eco-friendly and various colors).

items.name: PETG / ABS
items.description: For mechanical parts that need durability and heat resistance.

items.title: Prototyping
items.description: Printing prototypes (Prototyping) for inventors and students.

items.title: Small Batch Production
items.description: Small batch production without the need for expensive molds.

items.title: Engineering Graduation Projects
items.description: Complete execution of complex mechanical structures.

items.title: Free DFM Consultation
items.description: We inform the customer before printing if their design needs modification to be stronger or less costly.

items.title: Post-Processing Service
items.description: You don't receive the part 'raw', but with options (sanding, painting, or assembly) to appear as a professional final product.

items.title: Technical Specifications Report
items.description: We provide the customer with a document explaining the infill percentage and layer height that was used for their part.

items.title: Fair Pricing System
items.description: We provide a price calculator based on (weight + printing time) to ensure cost transparency.

items.title: Express Printing Option
items.description: For those with urgent project deliveries (within 24 hours).

cta.title: Ready to Bring Your Design to Life?
cta.description: Contact us to discuss your 3D printing needs and get a quote for your project.
